name: Remington Hair Dryer R-6010 Professional Ionic Dryer with 3 Speed Settings and DC Strong Motor
description:
Experience salon-quality results at home or in your salon with the Remington Hair Dryer R-6010, a professional-grade dryer designed for both commercial and personal use. Equipped with a DC strong motor and Heat Balance Technology, it delivers powerful, steady airflow while protecting hair from overheating. With 3 temperature controls (Cool, Mild, Hot) and 2 speed settings, it allows full styling flexibility for every hair type. The Ionic function reduces frizz, enhances shine, and ensures soft, smooth results. Complete with 2 air concentrators for customized airflow, this durable dryer combines performance, power, and precision for flawless styling every time.
Key Features:
 Model: R-6010
 Professional and home-use design with long-life DC motor
 3 temperature modes — Cool, Mild, and Hot
 2 speed settings with easy on/off switch
 Ionic function for smooth, frizz-free shine
 Centralized wind power for focused drying
 Comes with 2 air concentrator nozzles for adjustable air pressure
 Strong and steady wind speed for faster drying
 Ergonomic, lightweight design for comfortable use
How to Use:
 Towel-dry your hair before using the dryer
 Select your preferred speed and temperature setting
 Use the concentrator nozzle for targeted styling
 Finish with the Cool setting to lock in shine and set your style
Safety Information:
 Do not use near water or with wet hands
 Keep away from children and flammable materials
 Unplug after use and let cool before storage
 Avoid blocking air inlet or outlet during use
Package Includes:
 1 × Remington Hair Dryer R-6010
 2 × Air Concentrator Nozzles
